commit.message:
LU-19276 tests: Verify invalid fs/pool/lqa/nodemap names

llapi_name_is_valid() was introduced as a common helper to check
whether a name is valid. Add tests to verify whether it can
reject various invalid filesystem, OST pool, LQA or nodemap names.
